title: Console first screen and not-found states: Home is crowded for a new admin, and two of four "not found" pages offer no way out
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · browser walk (runner C) · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

- Home for a new administrator: the seven-row "Get your system ready" card plus a separate "Work here from your AI assistant" card fill the first screen; "Connect an AI assistant" appears twice. On a 390 px phone the checklist is the whole first viewport.
- Not-found states: unknown object → "Object Not Found"; unknown route → "Page not found" with Go back; unknown record → "Record not found"; unknown app → "This app can't be opened" with Retry. Only two offer a way out, and the wording differs per case.

## Proposed change

Fold the AI card into the checklist row it duplicates and collapse completed rows; give the four not-found states one component with the same wording family and a way back (Home / the parent list).

## Business reason

Who: every new administrator on first sign-in, and anyone following a stale link. Cost: the first screen hides the work, and dead-end pages strand users.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `ui/` (Home first-run checklist, not-found surfaces).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack session expired page not found` (152) and #30125 (first-run frictions, closed), #32021 (open, clean self-hosted first-run: sign-up page wording) — related area, different items.
